provenance: Original teaching documents and manually assigned four-dimensional vectors by Project Mastery contributors. These are synthetic teaching vectors, not embeddings from a trained model.

documents.title: Keep context at passage boundaries
documents.text: Split a document into smaller passages before indexing. Overlap repeats words around a boundary so a sentence is less likely to lose its surrounding context. More overlap also duplicates storage and retrieval results.

documents.title: Compare directions in embedding space
documents.text: An embedding represents a document or query as a vector. Cosine similarity compares direction rather than magnitude. Normalize both vectors and rank documents by their dot product. Define an explicit convention for zero vectors.

documents.title: Measure retrieval quality
documents.text: Recall measures the fraction of relevant documents retrieved. Reciprocal rank measures how early the first relevant document appears. Evaluate across a fixed collection of queries and relevance labels. Inspect failures before changing the system.

documents.title: Keep private text under control
documents.text: Local processing can keep private documents on a device. Decide what leaves the device before adding a hosted service. Logs should avoid recording raw queries or source documents when those contain sensitive material.

documents.title: Combine keyword and vector search
documents.text: Keyword search finds exact terms. Vector search can find related concepts even when wording differs. Reciprocal rank fusion combines ranked lists without assuming their scores share a scale. Compare the combined system against each baseline.

documents.title: Check a derivative numerically
documents.text: Evaluate a function on both sides of a point to estimate its derivative. Central differences help check an analytic gradient. Very small steps can amplify rounding error, while large steps introduce approximation error.
